entries.message: 'LibraryWall Silver': Every triangle in the lightmap UV layout of the Mesh used by this instance has zero area, so it cannot receive a usable lightmap. Provide lightmap UVs, enable 'Generate Lightmap UVs' in the Model Import Settings, or set the Mesh Renderer to receive Global Illumination from Light Probes.
